title: Pull-Back Crossover Escape
description: Against a defender who cuts off the drive, the ball handler pulls the ball back with two dribbles and crosses into the open side.

content.objective: Create space from a beaten-to-the-spot defender with a pull-back dribble, then cross into the space the defender left.
content.setup: Offense at the right wing, defense set to cut off a baseline drive.
content.organization: Live 1v1; rotate offense to defense to line.
instructions: When the defender cuts it off, take one or two backward pull-back dribbles with the right hand.
As the defender follows, cross the ball to the left hand.
Attack the middle of the floor to the rim or a pull-up.
coachingPoints: Pull back on a slight angle, keeping the body between defender and ball.
Cross only when the defender commits forward.
commonMistakes: Pulling back so far the move takes too long.
Crossing while the defender is still balanced.
High crossover that the defender deflects.
content.safety: Defenders play legally: no hand-checking or pushing the dribbler.
progressions: Defender may trap with a second player after the pull-back.
Finish with a kick-out pass to the corner.
regressions: Defender walks to the cut-off spot on cue.
variations: Pull-back into a step-back jump shot.
Pull-back from the top of the key.
successCriteria: Creates at least an arm-length of space with the pull-back.
Crosses only when the defender's weight goes forward.
content.gameApplication: The pull-back crossover turns a stopped drive into a new advantage instead of a turnover.
